DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で住んでいるので、住民票の通数は二通と書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人世帯の住民票は通数も二通か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two of us living together, so should I write two as the number of copies of the residence certificate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a residence certificate for a two-person household also requires two copies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通数は必要な証明書の数です。記載する方の人数とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The number of copies means the number of certificates needed. It is separate from how many people are listed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 提出先からは世帯の一通と言われています。人数と混ぜて考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先は世帯一通指定で人数と混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The place I am submitting it to asked for one copy for the household. I confused it with the number of people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the submission destination specifies one household copy and you confused that with the number of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、誰の情報を載せる指定なのかと、何通必要なのかを別々に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check separately whose information is required and how many copies are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人の情報を載せた一通という案内です。通数の欄は一と書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人分の情報入り一通なので通数を一へ訂正すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The instructions say one copy containing both people's information. I will change the copies field to one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will correct the copy count to one because one certificate containing both people's information is required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望を受付で伝えてください。記載内容は提出先の案内も見ながら確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell reception that preference. We will check the contents while looking at the submission destination's instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内の紙を持っています。名前の一覧と通数を一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内紙を示し氏名対象と通数の照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the instruction sheet. Could you compare the list of names to be included and the number of copies together?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the instructions and ask in Japanese for the names to be covered and the number of copies to be compared.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、拝見します。申請前に情報の対象と通数を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I will look. Let us clarify whose information and how many copies before the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人の情報を含む一通が必要だと伝え、書き直した欄を確認して申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人記載の一通を希望し訂正欄を確認して申請すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say I need one copy containing both people's information, check the corrected field, and apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want one copy listing two people and will check the corrected field before applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの窓口で確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この薬の名前を書きましたが、今は飲んでいません。問診の欄を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現在飲んでいない薬を問診へ記入したため訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote this medication's name, but I am not taking it now. I would like to correct the questionnaire field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you entered a medication you are not currently taking on the questionnaire and want to correct it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「現在飲んでいる薬」の欄ですね。最後に飲んだのはいつでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You mean the field for medications currently being taken. When did you last take it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨年です。薬の名前を知っているという意味で、ここへ書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最終使用は昨年で知る薬名を現在欄へ書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last year. I wrote it here to mean it was a medication name I knew.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you last used it last year and wrote the name of a medication you knew in the current-medication field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の服薬と以前の服薬を区別しましょう。以前の薬については担当へ説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish current from past medication. You can explain the previous medication to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨年飲んだ薬として別にメモします。今の薬は、お薬手帳の最新のページで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 過去薬を別にメモし現在薬は手帳最新頁で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will note it separately as medication taken last year. I would like to check my current medication against the latest page of my medication notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will note the past medication separately and check current medication on the notebook's latest page.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの資料を診療担当へ見せてください。記録だけで現在の服用を決めず、実際に飲んでいる物もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show the documents you have to the clinical staff. Do not determine current use from records alone; also tell them what you are actually taking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手帳にある物でも、現在使っていない薬は使っていないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手帳掲載でも現在未使用なら未使用と正確に伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if something is in the notebook, I will say I am not using it if I am not currently taking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will accurately report non-use of a medication you are not currently using even if it is listed in the notebook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。服用の判断や変更はここで行わず、疑問は担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Do not make decisions or changes about taking medication here; please check any questions with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現在飲む物と過去の薬を分けて説明し、問診の記載を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在服薬と過去薬を分け担当に問診内容を確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain current medication separately from past medication and ask them to check the questionnaire entries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will distinguish current and past medications and ask the person in charge to check the questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その相談内容を診療担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell the clinical staff what you want to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない相手に現在地を送ってしまいました。画面から消しましたが、相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない相手へ現在地送信後に画面を消した経緯を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I sent my current location to someone I do not know. I deleted it from the screen, but I would like advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese what happened after you sent your current location to a stranger and deleted it from the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いま相手が近くにいるなど、差し迫った危険を感じていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you feel any immediate danger, such as the person being nearby now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は店の中にいて相手は見えません。ただ、送った場所はこの店です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店内にいて相手は見えないが店の位置を送ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am inside a shop and cannot see the person now. However, the location I sent is this shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are inside a shop and cannot see the person, but sent the shop's location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 安全な場所から相談しましょう。消したのは、ご自身の画面のメッセージでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us discuss it from somewhere safe. Was what you deleted the message on your own screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分の画面から消せば、相手にも届かないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分画面の削除で相手に届かないと思っていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I thought deleting it from my own screen would mean it would not reach the other person either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought deleting it from your screen would prevent the other person receiving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その操作だけで相手が見ていないとは判断できません。送信した時刻や残る記録を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That action alone does not tell us the other person has not seen it. Please tell us when you sent it and what records remain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十五分前です。相手の名前が出た別の画面は残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送信は十五分前で相手名の別画面が残ると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Fifteen minutes ago. Another screen showing the person's name remains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you sent it fifteen minutes ago and another screen with the person's name remains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残る記録は消さずに、相談担当へ示してください。相手とのやり取りを続けて確かめる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not delete the remaining records; show them to the consultation staff. There is no need to keep communicating with the person to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相手には連絡せず、店内の安全な所から送信時刻と残る画面を見せて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手へ連絡せず安全な店内で時刻と記録を示して相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not contact the person. I will ask for advice from a safe place inside the shop, showing the time sent and the remaining screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not contact the person and will show the time and records while consulting from a safe place in the shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。危険が迫る場合はすぐ助けを求めてください。相談を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. If danger becomes imminent, seek help immediately. We will listen to your concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 箱の寸法を家で測りましたが、ふたが膨らみました。測った数字で申し込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 膨らんだ箱を以前測った寸法で発送申込できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I measured the box at home, but its lid has bulged up. Can I apply using the measurements I took?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can apply to send the bulging box using previously measured dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送する状態の大きさを確認します。ふたはまだ閉じていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check its size in the condition in which it will be sent. Is the lid still not closed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 服を詰めたら少し浮きました。押さえている間だけ、前の高さになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服でふたが浮き押さえる時だけ元の高さになると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It lifted a little after I packed the clothes. It is only at the previous height while I hold it down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that clothes have lifted the lid and it is only at the original height when held down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 押して小さく見せるのでなく、きちんと閉じられる梱包に整えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than pressing it down to make it look smaller, let us arrange the packaging so it closes properly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 無理に押し込まず、服を一枚取り出して閉じ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 強く押さず服一枚を出してふたを閉じ直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to take out one item of clothing and close it again instead of forcing it down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to remove one item of clothing and close the lid again without pressing hard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この作業台で整理できます。中身が減った後も、外側から寸法を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can organize it on this work counter. Even after removing contents, we will check the dimensions from the outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ふたを閉じても角が出ていたら、その出ている部分も含めますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 閉じた箱の突き出た角も寸法へ含めると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If a corner still sticks out after I close the lid, I should include that protruding part too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that a protruding corner of the closed box is included in its dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。最終的に送る形で確認します。料金はその状態を基に案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will check the final shape being sent. We will quote the price based on that condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 服を減らしてふたを閉じ、外側の一番出た所まで測り直してから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 服を減らし閉じて最大外寸を測り直して申込すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will remove some clothing, close the lid, and measure again up to the outermost protruding point before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will remove clothing, close the box, remeasure the maximum outer dimensions, and then apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。整いましたら窓口へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let the counter know when you are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 振込金額が思っていた額より大きく見えます。まだ実行していないので、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未実行の振込画面で金額が大きく見えるため確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The transfer amount looks larger than I expected. I have not executed it yet, so I would like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for help checking a transfer amount that looks too large on the screen before execution.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入力画面の金額と、請求書にある額を分けて読みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us read the amount on the entry screen separately from the amount on the invoice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 請求書は五万円ですが、画面には五十万円とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 請求書五万円と画面五十万円の差を具体的に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The invoice is fifty thousand yen, but the screen says five hundred thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese the difference between fifty thousand yen on the invoice and five hundred thousand yen on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ゼロが一つ多く入っていますね。確定せず、金額欄へ戻って直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is one extra zero. Let us go back to the amount field and correct it without confirming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 数字を消して五万円へ入れ直します。ゼロの数だけでなく、表示された額を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ゼロ過多を直し数字の並びでなく金額として読み直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will clear the number and reenter fifty thousand yen. I will read the displayed amount, not just count the zeros.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will correct the extra zero and reread it as a monetary amount rather than just a sequence of digits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。区切りの位置と、確認画面の金額も見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please also review the separator positions and the amount on the confirmation screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 五万円になりました。手数料の欄と振込額の欄は別なので、それぞれ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五万円への修正を報告し手数料と振込額を別々に確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is fifty thousand yen now. The fee field and transfer amount field are separate, so I will check each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese the correction to fifty thousand yen and say you will check the fee and transfer amount separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのとおりです。合計の表示も、振込額と手数料を分けて読んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is right. Read the total display with the transfer amount and fee distinguished too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 請求書の五万円と振込額が一致し、手数料も確認できてから実行します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 請求額との一致と手数料を確認後に実行すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will execute it after checking that the transfer amount matches the invoice's fifty thousand yen and confirming the fee too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will execute after confirming the invoice amount matches and checking the fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。操作後は控えをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the transaction record after the operation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: かごが一杯で、この袋にも商品を入れました。袋の中はまだ会計していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋内の商品が未会計でかごが一杯だったため入れたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My basket was full, so I also put products in this bag. I have not paid for what is in the bag yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare in Japanese that the products in the bag are unpaid and you put them there because your basket was full.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。袋の中の商品もこちらの台へ出していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling us. Could you put the products in the bag on this counter too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。先に買った物ではなく、この店で選んだ牛乳とパンです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店で選んだ牛乳とパンで会計済み品でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They are not things I bought earlier; they are milk and bread I selected in this store.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that they are milk and bread selected in this store, rather than already-paid items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでは同じ会計で登録します。ほかに袋へ入れた商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we will enter them in the same transaction. Have you put any other products in the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 底に小さい調味料もあります。見えにくいので、袋から全部出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋底の小調味料も示し全商品を出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is also a small seasoning container at the bottom. It is hard to see, so I will take everything out of the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the small seasoning item at the bottom and explain in Japanese that you will take all the products out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。かごの商品と合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We will check them together with the products in the basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会計後は、この同じ袋へ入れたいです。今は空にしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計後に同じ袋を使うため現在空にすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to put them in this same bag after checkout. I will leave it empty for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you will empty the bag now so you can use the same bag after checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、登録が終わってから袋へ戻せます。合計をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can put them back after entry is finished. Please check the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かごと袋の全部が含まれていることを確認して払います。会計後に袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: かごと袋の商品が全部登録されたと確認し支払後に袋へ入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check that everything from both the basket and bag is included before paying. I will put it in the bag after checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will confirm all basket and bag items are entered and bag them after paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お忘れ物のないよう、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please make sure not to leave anything behind and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 犬に水を飲ませたいです。この飲み口へ直接口を付けさせてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬を給水設備の飲み口へ直接近づけてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to give my dog water. May I let the dog put its mouth directly on this drinking spout?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may bring your dog directly to the water facility's drinking spout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは人用の飲み口です。犬を直接近づけないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a drinking spout for people. Please do not bring the dog directly to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 人用でしたか。犬用の器を持っているので、こちらを使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人用と理解し持参犬用容器を使いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is for people. I have a dog bowl with me, so I would like to use that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you understand it is for people and want to use the dog bowl you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、容器へ入れるための蛇口は別になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to these instructions, there is a separate tap for filling containers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人用の飲み口ではなく、別の蛇口から自分の器へ入れるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別蛇口から自分の器へ給水する方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I should fill my own bowl from the separate tap rather than the drinking spout for people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the method of filling your own bowl from a separate tap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。器を蛇口に触れさせず、水が周囲へこぼれないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Do not let the bowl touch the tap, and avoid spilling water around it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 犬は連れに持っていてもらい、私が器に入れてから離れた所で飲ませます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者に犬を持ってもらい自分が給水し離れた場所で飲ませると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will have my companion hold the dog while I fill the bowl, then give the dog water somewhere farther away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your companion will hold the dog while you fill the bowl and you will give the dog water away from the tap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。利用後は蛇口が閉まっていることも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please also check the tap is turned off after use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 器を使って別の場所で飲ませ、蛇口を閉じたことを確かめてから散歩へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 器で別場所へ給水し蛇口閉栓確認後に散歩を再開すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the bowl to give the dog water elsewhere, check that I have closed the tap, and then resume our walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will use the bowl to give water elsewhere and resume walking after checking the tap is closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どうぞ安全にお散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please enjoy your walk safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この矢印の列車に乗りたいのですが、私の目的地へ向かう表示でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 到着画面の矢印列車が目的地方面の発車表示か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take the train shown by this arrow. Is this showing a departure toward my destination?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the train indicated by an arrow on an arrivals screen shows a departure toward your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの画面は「到着」とあります。乗車する列車は発車の案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This screen says arrivals. We check the train you will board using the departures information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅に向かって来る列車の表示なのですね。出発する向きだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着を出発方向と誤解していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it shows trains coming toward the station. I thought it showed the direction of departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook arrivals for the departure direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。別の画面に「発車」の表題があります。目的地はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. A different screen has the heading departures. Where is your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この紙の駅へ行きます。到着する列車名が似ていて、同じ列車だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的駅の紙を示し似た到着列車名で同一と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am going to the station on this paper. The arriving train's name was similar, so I thought it was the same train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the paper with your destination station and explain in Japanese that the similar name of an arriving train made you think it was the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前だけでなく行先と時刻を照合しましょう。この練習用発車欄に目的地の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us compare the destination and time, not just the name. Your destination is shown in this practice departures column.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見つかりました。矢印だけで判断せず、発車欄の行先を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 矢印だけでなく発車欄の行先を読むと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I found it. I will read the destination in the departures column instead of judging by the arrow alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will read the departures column's destination rather than just the arrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認が大切です。乗車位置の案内も発車欄の列車に合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: That check is important. Please also follow boarding-position information for the train in the departures column.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 目的地と発車時刻を確認できたので、この列車の乗車位置へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目的地と発車時刻に合う列車の乗車位置へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed the destination and departure time, so I will go to this train's boarding position.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will go to the boarding position for the train matching your destination and departure time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Take care and have a good journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相談予約に国籍を書きました。これだけで通訳の言語も伝わるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約の国籍記入だけで通訳言語が伝わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote my nationality when booking a consultation. Will that alone also communicate the language I need for interpreting?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether entering nationality alone when booking conveys the interpreting language.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 国籍と、相談に使いたい言語は別に確認します。希望の言語を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We check nationality separately from the language you want to use in the consultation. Please tell me your preferred language.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。日本語も少し話せますが、手続きの説明はベトナム語で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日本語も少し話すが手続き説明はベトナム語を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese. I can speak a little Japanese too, but I would like to hear the procedure explained in Vietnamese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you speak a little Japanese but want the procedure explained in Vietnamese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。話す言語の希望として記録します。資料は何語が読みやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We will record that as your preferred spoken language. What language is easiest for you to read documents in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資料もベトナム語が読みやすいです。ただ、書類の日本語の名前も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料はベトナム語で元の日本語書類名も知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Vietnamese is easier for documents too. However, I would also like to know the documents' Japanese names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want documents in Vietnamese and also want to know the original Japanese document names.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では説明の際、元の書類名も対応させて確認できるよう相談担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then we will tell the consultation staff to explain in a way that lets you match the original document names too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 利用できる通訳がまだ決まっていなければ、予約確定の連絡を待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通訳未確定なら手配確認の連絡を待ちたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: If an available interpreter has not been decided yet, I would like to wait for confirmation of the booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to wait for confirmation of the arrangements if the interpreter is not yet confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。手配の可否を確認してから連絡するという相談にします。必ず手配できるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will arrange to contact you after checking whether an interpreter can be provided. We cannot always guarantee one can be arranged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 国籍とは別にベトナム語の説明と資料を希望し、手配の確認後に日時を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 国籍と別に言語希望を申告し手配確認後に日時を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Separately from nationality, I would like explanations and documents in Vietnamese. I will decide the date and time after the arrangements are checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will state your language preference separately from nationality and decide the date and time after checking arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認の連絡方法をこちらで伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ask here how to contact you with the confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計の番号を取りましたが、まだ診察を受けていません。ここで待てば受付したことになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未受診で会計番号だけ取得した状態が診察受付済みか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took a payment number, but I have not been seen by a doctor yet. Does waiting here mean I have checked in for the consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether taking only a payment number before being seen counts as checking in for a consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察の受付とは別です。今日は初めてのご来院でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is separate from consultation check-in. Is this your first visit here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。入口にあった機械の番号を取れば、全部済むと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 初来院で機械番号一つですべて済むと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought taking one number from the machine at the entrance would handle everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is your first visit and you thought one machine-issued number took care of everything.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここでは、最初に診察受付で用件を伝えます。会計の順番で受診するわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here you first tell the consultation reception why you are visiting. Your consultation is not arranged in payment-number order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ診察受付に名前を伝えていません。先にそちらへ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 氏名未申告なので診察受付へ先に行きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not given my name to consultation reception yet. I would like to go there first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not stated your name and want to go to consultation reception first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察受付へご案内します。誤って取った会計番号の扱いは担当に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will guide you to consultation reception. We will tell the person in charge about the payment number you took by mistake.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号を黙って捨てず、会計受付で間違えたことも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誤取得番号を黙って処分せず経緯を説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not quietly throw away this number. I will also explain that I made a mistake at payment reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not silently discard the number taken by mistake and will explain what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。予約の有無と受診の用件を診察受付でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Please tell consultation reception whether you have an appointment and why you need to be seen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に会計番号を取ってしまったと伝え、診察の受付から手順を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計番号の誤取得を知らせ診察受付から手順を確認すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I took a payment number first by mistake and check the procedure starting with consultation reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will explain the mistaken payment number and check the steps starting with consultation reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの診察受付へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come to consultation reception here.
